Name: Melee Weapon Optimization
Author: huanfeng520
Description:
[b][size=5]Melee Weapon Optimization[/size][/b]

[size=4]Description[/size]

[size=3]This is a SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley that improves the feel of normal melee weapons.[/size]
[size=3]It lets the player move while using normal melee attacks and fixes the attack direction.[/size]

[size=4]Installation instructions[/size]

Place the mod folder into:
[quote]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/quote]Then launch the game through SMAPI.
[size=4]Main features[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Move while swinging normal melee weapons[/*]
[*]Attack movement speed will not exceed the player's original speed[/*]
[*]Supports both mobile and PC controls[/*]
[*]Mobile can follow movement direction[/*]
[*]PC can follow mouse direction[/*]
[*]Does not affect tools, fishing rods, slingshots, charged actions, or special attacks[/*]
[/list][size=4]Requirements[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional; config can also be edited manually[/*]
[/list]Recommended config:

[quote]{
  "Version": "2.2.0",
  "OverrideMoveSpeed": true,
  "MoveSpeed": 1.0,
  "MoveWhileSwingingMeleeWeapons": true,
  "FixMeleeWeaponFacing": true,
  "FacingMode": "MobileMovement"
}[/quote][b]For [color=#00ff00]PC[/color], change `[color=#ff0000] MobileMovement [/color]` to `"[color=#00ff00]PCMouse[/color]"`.[/b]

For [b][color=#ff0000]Android [/color][/b]users, I recommend the following two UI layouts shown below.
[img width=400,height=200]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/45967/45967-1778245563-801210310.png[/img]


Config file location:


[quote]Stardew Valley/Mods/MeleeWeaponOptimization/config.json[/quote][size=4]Shout outs[/size]
Thanks to the original author, Shockah.
This version is based on the original mod and focuses on improving movement and facing for normal melee weapons.
